protocol: Test images only (70% of each benchmark's images, split by a fixed hash of the image id); the same questions and option order for every system; each system gets its own temperature fitted on the same calibration images. TallyQA is the full test build with GQA-training duplicates removed. API probabilities are returned to two decimals and floored at 0.005; a failed request counts as a uniform guess. NLL and ECE after temperature scaling; AUROC of the top probability for correct vs. wrong answers. Macro is the equal-weight mean of the four benchmarks.
